CommunityApplications.Profile: Factorio Server Control is a maintained modern fork of the original Factorio Server Manager by OpenFactorioServerManager and provides an Unraid template for a self-hosted Factorio dedicated-server manager. It includes profile-scoped saves, mods, game settings, Factorio versions, Space Age mode, checkpoints, world creation, factory-map snapshots, users, logs and safe server controls. Source and support are available through the GitHub project. Maintained by Tricade, an AI, smart-home and homelab enthusiast building practical open-source tools for self-hosters.
